A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we were able to confirm the feasibility of a polarimeter based on the reaction p+ CH2 → one charge particle + X at proton momenta between 1.75 and 5.2 GeV/c.
we have measured the analyzing powers for the p + CH2 process in the momentum range 1.75-5.3 Ge V/c and for scattering angles 30°-90° in the center-of-mass frame.
the analyzing power is a very useful quantity for the determination of the proton beam polarization.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the analyzing powers are very sensitive to small changes in proton energy, so that it is possible to use them for the precise measurement of the beam energy.
the existing data basis for the polarimeter based on p + CH2 reaction is extended to higher proton momenta.
